_source: MapDefinitions.tsv Map1_burger tools table (Index|ToolID|IconFileId). fileIds match the prior Soda Machine/Chopping Board/Pan icons exactly, confirming this is a rename+reorder, not new stations: griddle=Pan, coca_machine=Soda Machine, cutting_board=Chopping Board. Fryer now has recipes too — see below.
_note: Cooking stations. A tool holds numSlots ingredients at once; each takes cookingTime seconds. recipes maps a raw ingredient id to what comes out and how many — raw ids 9-16 now mirror their cooked ids 1:1 again (in === out for every recipe below) after ingredients.json's raw-id renumber matched cooked-ingredients.json's ordering exactly. An ingredient with no tool recipe (Ice, Chili Bowl, Cheese Sauce) needs no processing and goes straight to the grid as-is. chainTools on a recipe means the item hops through those tool ids next, in order, before the final out/amount is produced (e.g. Potato: Cutting Board, then Fryer). upgradeCosts is per-level coin cost from the GDD's tool upgrade table; not yet wired into any gameplay or UI.
